description: Search for messages across all channels in a guild using Discord's native search API. Returns at most 25 messages matching the query with channel context, with no way to page past them. Age-restricted (NSFW) channels are left out. Requires the Read Message History permission and the Message Content privileged intent, enabled in the Developer Portal. While Discord is still building the server's search index, the call fails and says how many seconds to wait. Use discord_search_messages for a substring scan of one channel's last 100 messages. To read the messages around a hit, use discord_read_messages with around.

author_id.description: Optional. Only show messages from this user ID.

channel_id.description: Optional. Restrict search to this channel ID.

name: discord_search_guild_messages

moreFields.description: Count of fields left out past the first 10. Absent when none were.
